chapter: Behold the Grandeur, Seize the Splendor
act_title: Behold the Grandeur, Seize the Splendor

quests.title: Behold the Grandeur, Seize the Splendor

dialogue.t: Yup! Looks like our Fungi buddies really did find some interesting spots nearby, and they're super curious about the little Yumkasaurs too!
Let's follow this special route and take a look around!
If you spot anything interesting along the way, just let Bongo-Head know so it can snap some great pictures with the Kamera!
Of course! It's Paimon's time to shine! Paimon will make sure that our Fungi friends enjoy this trip to the fullest!

quests.description: After a long trek, you and your Fungi companions arrive at the first scenic spot. After confirming their points of interest, you begin your special tour…
